name: data.gov
label: data.gov
description: data.gov official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: search, keywords, organizations, locations_search, location_get, harvest_record, harvest_record_raw, harvest_record_transformed. Docs: https://resources.data.gov/catalog-api/. Catalog API v4 at https://api.gsa.gov/technology/datagov/v4. The CKAN host catalog.data.gov/api/3 was retired and is deliberately unused. Auth header X-Api-Key from configuration api_key. US catalog metadata is generally public-domain; honor each dataset license. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One data.gov request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Do not put the API key on this port. Example: {"operation":"search","q":"climate"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: search | keywords | organizations | locations_search | location_get | harvest_record | harvest_record_raw | harvest_record_transformed. Default: search. Example: search.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Full-text query for search, or place name for locations_search. Optional. Example: climate.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: search only. EXACT: relevance | popularity | distance | last_harvested_date. Omit for relevance.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: search only. Page size, integer, minimum 1. Omit for the provider default 10.

schema.label: org_slug
schema.description: search only. Organization slug from organizations, for example nasa.

schema.label: org_type
schema.description: search only. EXACT: Federal Government | City Government | State Government | County Government | University | Tribal | Non-Profit.

schema.label: keyword
schema.description: search only. One exact keyword. Omit when unused.

schema.label: spatial_filter
schema.description: search only. EXACT: geospatial | non-geospatial. Omit when unused.

schema.label: spatial_geometry
schema.description: search only. GeoJSON geometry string. Omit when unused.

schema.label: spatial_within
schema.description: search only. true or false. Omit for false (intersect).

schema.label: after
schema.description: search only. Cursor from the previous response after field. Omit on the first page.

schema.label: size
schema.description: keywords or locations_search. Integer count. Omit for the provider default.

schema.label: min_count
schema.description: keywords only. Minimum dataset count. Omit for 1.

schema.label: location_id
schema.description: Required for location_get. UUID from locations_search.

schema.label: record_id
schema.description: Required for harvest_record, harvest_record_raw, and harvest_record_transformed. UUID.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: search, keywords, organizations, locations_search, location_get, harvest_record, harvest_record_raw, harvest_record_transformed.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret sent as header X-Api-Key. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT. The provider trial value DEMO_KEY is rate-limited.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 30. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
